title: Walden University (Walden)
summary: Walden University (Walden) is a university in Minneapolis. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Walden.

sections.heading: What Walden is known for
paragraphs: Walden University (Walden) is a private for-profit institution known for its focus on health and business programs. Approximately 31.48% of its academic offerings are dedicated to health-related fields, making it a significant area of study for its students. Business programs also represent a notable portion, accounting for about 11.89% of the curriculum. The university serves an undergraduate population of 9,136 students, reflecting its role in providing higher education opportunities primarily in these disciplines.
